data.name: Mudhakkir
data.gender_notes: Mudhakkir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who reminds, reminds others of Allah, or remembers Allah frequently. Derived from the Arabic verb 'dhakara' meaning 'to remind'. The name Mudhakkir carries the meaning “Reminder, Memorizer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mudhakkir usually hope their child will grow to embody reminder, memorizer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a constant reminder of Allah in one's daily life.
data.etymology: Mudhakkir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reminder, Memorizer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mudhakkir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مُذَكِّر
in_arabic.meaning: الذي يذكر الله كثيرًا، أو من يذكر الناس بالخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُذَكِّر هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الذي يذكر الله تعالى في كل الأوقات، أو الشخص الذي يذكر الناس بالخير والصلاح. ورد هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَذَكِرِ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ' (الأعراف: 205). يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء ذات الدلالة العميقة في الإسلام، حيث يشير إلى أهمية الذكر والشكر لله في حياة المسلم.

in_urdu.name: مُذَكِّر
in_urdu.meaning: جو اللہ کو بہت یاد کرتا ہے، یا جو لوگوں کو بھلائی کی یاد दिलاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُذَكِّر اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اللہ تعالیٰ کو ہر وقت یاد کرتا ہے، یا وہ شخص جو لوگوں کو نیکی اور بھلائی کی یاد दिलاتا ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں کئی جگہوں پر آیا ہے، جیسے کہ ارشاد ربانی: 'وَذَكِرِ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ' (الأعراف: 205). یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں گہری اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی یاد اور شکر کی اہمیت پر زور دیتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुज़क्किर
in_hindi.meaning: जो व्यक्ति अल्लाह को बहुत याद करता है या जो लोगों को अच्छे कामों की याद दिलाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुज़क्किर अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो अल्लाह को हर समय याद करता है या जो लोगों को अच्छे कामों और नेकियों की याद दिलाता है। यह नाम कुरआन में कई जगहों पर आया है, जैसे कि 'وَذَكِرِ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ' (الأعراف: 205)। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह अल्लाह की याद और शेष मुस्लिम परंपरा में इसकी महत्ता को रेखांकित करता है।

in_pashto.name: مُذَكِّر
in_pashto.meaning: هغه کسي چه ډير اللّٰه يادوي، يا هغه کسي چه خلکو ته د نيکيو يادونه کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُذَكِّر د اللّٰه ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی، او معنی يې ده هغه کسي چه اللّٰه تعالی په هر وخت کې يادوي، يا هغه کسي چه خلکو ته د نيکيو او صلاح يادونه کوي. دا نوم د قرآن کريم په ډيرو ځايونو کې راغلی دی، لکه څيره چې فرمايي: 'وَذَكِرِ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ' (الأعراف: 205). دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دوديز ارزښتونو په منځ کې ډير اهميت لري، ځکه چې د اللّٰه يادولو او شکر کولو پر اهميت ټينګار کوي.

in_english.name: Mudhakkir
in_english.meaning: One who remembers Allah frequently or reminds people of good deeds
in_english.long_meaning: Mudhakkir is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning one who remembers Allah frequently or reminds people of good deeds and righteousness. This name is mentioned in the Quran in several places, such as 'and remember Allah frequently, that you may be successful' (Al-A'raf: 205). In Islamic tradition, this name holds deep significance, emphasizing the importance of remembering and thanking Allah, and reminding others of moral and spiritual duties.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mudhakkir" holds a special place in Islamic culture, as it is a reminder of the importance of dhikr, or frequent remembrance of Allah in daily life. It is a name that encourages mindfulness and spiritual awareness, reminding individuals to stay connected to their faith and values.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name "Mudhakkir" holds deep significance. It represents a person who is constantly engaged in dhikr, or remembering Allah through various means such as recitation of the Quran, remembrance of Allah's name and attributes, or performing good deeds. This constant remembrance is a means to strengthen one's faith and seek nearness to Allah. The name is also a reminder of the importance of encouraging others to remember Allah and helping them stay on the right path. Overall, the name "Mudhakkir" embodies the Islamic values of mindfulness, spiritual growth, and community support.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah The name Mudhakkir carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mudhakkir ibn Dhakwan was an Ansari (helper of the Prophet Muhammad) and one of the earliest converts to Islam. He was known for his excellent memory and was entrusted by the Prophet with the task of teaching the Quran to new converts. He earned the nickname Mudhakkir (the Rememberer) due to his diligent efforts in preserving and transmitting knowledge.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Maqrizi's Al-Khitat Al-Khayrfiyah The name Mudhakkir carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mudhakkir ibn Mansur was a scholar, judge, and historian in Egypt during the Mamluk Sultanate. He was known for his extensive knowledge of Islamic history and jurisprudence, and was given the nickname Mudhakkir (the Rememberer) due to his prodigious memory.
